name: Thorgas Grimson
summary: Inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Thorgas Grimson teaches new hunters to face Dun Morogh's frozen wilds. The seasoned outdoorsman trusts experience in the cold to teach survival.

sections.title: A Guide in the Cold
sections.body: Inside Anvilmar, Thorgas Grimson guides new mountaineers and scouts. He leaves dry lessons behind and sends young hunters into the freezing winds. With bow or gun in hand, they track Dun Morogh's rugged beasts firsthand.

faq.answer: Thorgas Grimson trains hunters inside Anvilmar, Coldridge Valley's central outpost in Dun Morogh. He gives new Alliance hunters their first guidance and teaches basic field skills.
Thorgas teaches new hunters wilderness skills, from tracking beasts across snowy ground to improving their ranged marksmanship. He sets them on the path to becoming mountaineers.
Thorgas believes the wild teaches more than theory. Hunters must enter the freezing drifts and face Dun Morogh's beasts to master the wild.

faq.q: Will Thorgas Grimson speak with non-hunters?
aliases: can other classes talk to thorgas
faq.answer: Thorgas politely tells adventurers of other callings that he cannot train them. He advises them to seek a mentor suited to their path.

angles.text: As a dwarf hunter, you may meet Thorgas Grimson as your first mentor. He offers early guidance in tracking beasts and surviving the freezing valley.
As a dwarf, you share the hardy, self-reliant spirit of the Ironforge mountaineers who patrol Dun Morogh's frozen peaks.
